body: ESTIMATE_PENDING_UNA. MAINLINE-012 rescales P2-A and P2-E to float margin 0 and 5 percent. Buckling uses knockdown 0.2 and scales linearly with it. Every value is QUESTIONABLE. At 500 m and margin 0, P2-E buckling SF is 0.170514658189 at 5 m, 0.233885578993 at 10 m, 0.242509518291 at 20 m and 0.243598488425 at 40 m. Above 10 m that curve is nearly size-invariant. The fixed 100 kg allowance spread at 5 m is -0.0537061668293. P2-A keeps a 0.1 m core, so it is not invariant: 0.23078902511 at 10 m, 0.165786898289 at 20 m, 0.0958662663699 at 40 m. P2-A at 5 m is infeasible. Infeasible rows in the grid: 4. At R = 10 m and margin 0, lift per unit pressure versus 500 m is 1.11441423822 at 5000 m and 1.31502423263 at 11000 m. P2-E buckling SF moves to 0.685700039007 and 0.373061196958 of the 500 m value. The cold-air fraction left in the safety factor is 0.615300859853 and 0.283691499898. The 1/T gain does not survive the rescale. Start 2026-10-19T23:08:49.605041-07:00. End 2026-10-19T23:08:49.605426-07:00. Elapsed 0.0003733930643647909 s, a measurement.
